query: My contract wants to help out other people's XOXNO lending accounts: add collateral to a user's position and pay down their debt when they ask.
expected_behavior: Calls supply(caller, account_id, spoke_id, assets) with the target's existing account_id (never 0, which would open a new account owned by the contract) and a spoke_id equal to the account's own spoke (mismatch reverts SpokeMismatch #310)

States that a non-owner, non-delegate caller can only top up hub assets the account already supplies; adding a new asset to someone else's account reverts NotAuthorized #44, so the contract checks get_collateral_amount(account_id, hub_asset) > 0 (or get_account_positions) before the authorize call

Calls repay(caller, account_id, payments) as a permissionless action needing only the contract's own authorization (no owner/delegate check), with excess refunded to the caller; does not attempt add_delegate or require the target to sign
Self-authorizes the exact token.transfer(contract -> pool, amount) sub-invocation immediately before each of supply and repay, with all controller reads placed before the authorize call
Does not call borrow or withdraw on the third party's account (those require owner or delegate authorization) and does not hardcode controller/pool addresses
machine_checkable: Generated Rust compiles with cargo build --target wasm32v1-none against soroban-sdk =27.0.6 and controller-interface
Source never passes the literal 0 as account_id to supply in the third-party path, and contains no `.borrow(` or `.withdraw(` call
Source contains no ControllerClient view call between `authorize_as_current_contract` and `.supply(` / `.repay(`
